• FedEx Ground: $36.61 (estimated delivery in 3 business days by End of Day)
• FedEx Express Saver: $77.02 (delivery in 3 business days by 5:00 PM)
• FedEx 2Day: $99.31 (delivery in 2 business days by 5:00 PM)
• FedEx 2Day (Saturday Delivery): $120.19 (delivery on Saturday by 5:00 PM)
• FedEx Priority Overnight: $201.69 (delivery next business day by 5:00 PM)
• FedEx First Overnight: $242.14 (delivery next business day early afternoon by 2:00 PM)

Note: Rates shown reflect drop-off at a FedEx location. Adding scheduled pickup adds $18.88 to each rate (e.g., FedEx Ground with pickup is $55.49).
